test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R is sitting third to the right of D. Only one person is sitting between G and E when counted from the left of G. S is sitting to the immediate right of T. Only one person is sitting between G and T when counted from the right of G. Who is sitting third to the right of F?
solution:
**Given:** Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) Only one person is sitting between G and E when counted from the left of G.

2) Only one person is sitting between G and T when counted from the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc595c066e0c4483329aad338635a5986db71ac77a4b5b5477265bd7c15cf434.png] 

3) S is sitting to the immediate right of T. 

4) R is sitting third to the right of D.

After positioning S, R and D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bda016c2297ed6f3fda7a235b57e870ac4c35f15a1b8a618554d722c46b69367.png] 

Thus, T is sitting third to the right of F. 

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
